results.title: ASTRONICS CORP - Form 10-Q - FY2018
results.snippet: Aerospace customers are the airframe manufacturers ("OEM") that build aircraft for the commercial, military and general aviation markets, suppliers to those OEM's, aircraft operators such as airlines and branches of the U.S. Department of Defense as well as the Federal Aviation Administration and airport operators.

results.title: ASTRONICS CORP - Form 10-K - FY2019
results.snippet: The company's 10-K lists electrical power generation and distribution systems, seat motion solutions, lighting and safety systems, avionics products, aircraft structures, systems certification, and automated test systems among its products and services.

results.title: ASTRONICS CORP - Form 10-K - FY2018
results.snippet: Test Systems designs, develops, manufactures and maintains automated test systems that support the semiconductor, aerospace, communications and weapons test systems as well as training and simulation devices for both commercial and military applications. Its customers are mainly OEM's and prime government contractors for both electronics and military products.
